summary: Macquarie Infrastructure Income Opportunities Fund filed an 8-K reporting the September 2026 monthly closing of its continuous private offering, selling 290,031.399 Class J common shares for $7.39 million at a purchase price equal to NAV per share of $25.48 as of August 31, 2026; share count finalized September 29, 2026. Sales were exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D or S, with accredited-investor or non-U.S.-person representations. Aggregate NAV was roughly $695.8 million. This is a routine interval-fund capital raise, not a special situation; watch subscription pace versus NAV marks.
